## User need

Describe the task that is difficult today and who would benefit.

## Proposed behavior

Explain the expected workflow, including confirmations and errors where useful.
Identify any device reads/writes, retained data, or additional tools it needs.

## Alternatives

Describe existing workarounds or a smaller improvement that would help.

## Scope and examples

Use fictional examples. Do not attach personal APKs, device inventories or
private paths. Note what can reasonably remain outside this proposal.
